# v0.12

Released 2026-11-06.

## Highlights

- Wine is now built from the patched `zwift-radios-rebased` fork with BLE support, which
  fixes the trainer pairing crash.
- The snap moves from core24 to core26, with unreachable libraries pruned from the snap.
- A visual smoke test, a Bluetooth plumbing test and a pairing-screen test (with faked login
  servers) were added, along with the in-workshop action runner and `AGENTS.md`.
